001package org.clafer.ir;
002
003import org.clafer.common.Check;
004import org.clafer.domain.Domain;
005import org.clafer.domain.Domains;
006
007/**
008 *
009 * @author jimmy
010 */
011public class IrIntVar extends IrAbstractInt implements IrVar {
012
013    private final String name;
014
015    IrIntVar(String name, Domain domain) {
016        super(domain);
017        this.name = Check.notNull(name);
018    }
019
020    IrIntVar(int constant) {
021        this(Integer.toString(constant), Domains.constantDomain(constant));
022    }
023
024    @Override
025    public String getName() {
026        return name;
027    }
028
029    @Override
030    public <A, B> B accept(IrIntExprVisitor<A, B> visitor, A a) {
031        return visitor.visit(this, a);
032    }
033
034    @Override
035    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
036        if (this == obj) {
037            return true;
038        }
039        if (obj instanceof IrIntVar) {
040            IrIntVar other = (IrIntVar) obj;
041            if (isConstant() && other.isConstant()) {
042                return getLowBound() == other.getLowBound();
043            }
044        }
045        return false;
046    }
047
048    @Override
049    public int hashCode() {
050        return name.hashCode();
051    }
052
053    @Override
054    public String toString() {
055        // TODO: return only name
056        return name + "{domain=" + getDomain() + "}";
057    }
058}
